message: Warranted, yes. I've done it and my grading criteria says I will do it if the assigned task is not completed, whether an in-class or revised writing. Maybe it might teach them to better read and follow directions. We don't want them directing fire at their comrades because they didn't pay attention to their orders/directions. Realistically though, a comp essay failing probably won't get them to think better about whatever they are tasked to do militarily, but the standards are reasonable. If you are given a task and you complete a different task, what else but a failure on the assigned task can be expected? Me, though, I would have given a D- rather than an F for this sort of thing, but that's nit-picking really. Good assignment by the way. It fits their context well but is a pretty standard fyc sort of thing to write on.
